notice: FICTIONAL SIMULATION ONLY. All procedures and time ranges are invented, are not service-level commitments, and exclude public holidays. Have a service owner review before any real-world use.

M01.title: Corporate Systems: Instability and Outages
M01.summary: Guidance for failures in everyday business systems that block time-sensitive work.

M02.title: Access and Credentials
M02.summary: Guidance for account lockouts, forgotten passwords, and access requests.

M03.title: Connectivity and Performance
M03.summary: Guidance for VPN interruptions, unstable networks, and slow systems.

M04.title: Devices and Workplace Equipment
M04.summary: Guidance for faulty peripherals and software installation requests.

M05.title: Portal Usage Guidance
M05.summary: Guidance for common questions about customer portal features.

M01-T01.title: Billing system freezing or unavailable
M01-T01.problem: The billing system freezes or closes during month-end work, preventing the finance team from issuing or checking entries.
M01-T01.solution: Use the contingency web version of the billing module, if authorized and available.
steps: Confirm whether the issue affects one workstation or several.
If the service owner has approved it, guide the user to the contingency web version with their own account.
Ask the user to save current work before switching access methods.
Send the approximate failure time and on-screen message to the technical team.

M01-T02.title: Payroll system error when generating payslips
M01-T02.problem: The payroll system reports an error while generating payslips or a payment file near its scheduled bank submission.
M01-T02.solution: Generate a batch export for review, if the responsible payroll owner authorizes this workaround.
steps: Record the exact error message and the generation step where it appears.
If approved by the payroll owner, guide the user through a batch export for review.
Make clear that the responsible team must verify the figures before sending anything.
Escalate the original module error to the technical team.

M01-T03.title: Corporate email will not open or send messages
M01-T03.problem: The email client will not open or send messages, and a message with an attachment is due at a scheduled time.
M01-T03.solution: Use the corporate webmail service in a browser, if available and authorized.
steps: Confirm whether the issue occurs only in the installed application or also in a browser.
If available, guide the user to corporate webmail using their own sign-in; never request or share their password.
For urgent work, use only an approved internal channel for the attachment.
Escalate recurring failures to the technical team.

M01-T04.title: Reports show outdated data
M01-T04.problem: Management reports show data from previous days, while a team needs current information for a meeting or deliverable.
M01-T04.solution: Use a direct-query export for review, only if the data owner authorizes it.
steps: Confirm which report is affected and the date of its latest update.
If permitted, guide the user through a direct-query spreadsheet export.
Ask the responsible business owner to verify exported figures before use.
Escalate the automatic refresh failure to the technical team.

M02-T01.title: Forgotten password or locked account
M02-T01.problem: The user cannot sign in to the portal because the password was forgotten or the account was locked after failed attempts.
M02-T01.solution: Use the portal's self-service password reset, if that feature is enabled.
steps: Follow the organization's approved identity-verification process; do not ask for a password or one-time code.
Guide the user to the portal's self-service reset link, if available.
If the account remains locked, route the request to the access team.
Ask the user to confirm whether they can sign in after the reset.

M02-T02.title: ERP access unavailable to a team
M02-T02.problem: An entire team has lost ERP access and cannot issue invoices or serve customers.
M02-T02.solution: Use an individually assigned contingency account only if approved by the system owner; do not share credentials.
steps: Confirm how many people are affected and when the outage began.
Check for a recorded maintenance notice or broader outage.
Ask the system owner to approve an individual contingency-access path for critical work.
Escalate as a team-impacting incident.

M02-T03.title: Request access to a shared folder
M02-T03.problem: A user requests access to another person's shared folder, such as an HR folder, within an agreed timeframe.
M02-T03.solution: Share only specifically approved files through an organization-approved, expiring link, if permitted.
steps: Confirm the requested folder and the business need without collecting unnecessary personal data.
Verify that the request has approval from the folder owner or manager.
If permitted, share only the requested files through an approved expiring link.
Submit the permanent permission request to the access team.

M02-T04.title: Two-factor verification code does not arrive
M02-T04.problem: The user does not receive a verification code by SMS or authenticator app and cannot complete sign-in.
M02-T04.solution: Use a previously generated recovery code only if the user still has it; never ask them to disclose it.
steps: Confirm the registered verification method and whether the device has signal and the correct time.
The user may enter their own recovery code if one is available; support staff must not collect it.
If no recovery option is available, route a verified reset request to the access team.
Ask the user to update their registered contact method after regaining access.

M03-T01.title: VPN disconnects repeatedly
M03-T01.problem: The VPN disconnects several times in one day, leaving the user without access to internal systems.
M03-T01.solution: Use an approved secure web portal that does not require VPN, if one is available.
steps: Confirm whether other users are affected or only this user.
If approved, guide the user to the secure web portal for the required systems.
A different network may be used as a diagnostic test only when policy allows it.
Escalate to the network team with the times of the disconnections.

M03-T02.title: System is slow but still working
M03-T02.problem: Systems respond more slowly than usual but work is not fully blocked.
M03-T02.solution: Schedule resource-intensive work outside peak hours, if the business owner agrees.
steps: Confirm whether slowness affects one system or several.
Suggest closing unused tabs and applications as a low-risk check.
If appropriate, schedule long reports or processing outside peak hours.
Record the issue for monitoring and avoid assigning urgency without evidence.

M03-T03.title: Office Wi-Fi is unstable
M03-T03.problem: The office wireless network drops or loses internet access for a group of people.
M03-T03.solution: Use a wired network connection at an available approved desk, if practical.
steps: Confirm how many people and which areas of the office are affected.
Where available, try an approved wired network connection.
Check for a known alternate office network only if authorized.
Escalate as a network infrastructure issue.

M03-T04.title: Video meeting has no audio or video
M03-T04.problem: The user cannot use a microphone, camera, or sound in a scheduled meeting.
M03-T04.solution: Join by phone using the meeting invitation's dial-in details, if provided and approved.
steps: Confirm the application and whether the device appears in its audio/video settings.
Check microphone and camera permissions in the browser or application.
If the meeting is imminent, use the invitation's phone option when available.
Record the issue for device support if it continues.

M04-T01.title: Department printer is unavailable
M04-T01.problem: A floor or department printer has stopped working and documents are needed for a same-day commitment.
M04-T01.solution: Use another printer already authorized for the user's department, if one is available.
steps: Confirm the floor, printer model, and any message on its display.
Identify an approved alternate printer for the department, if available.
If suitable, save documents as PDF for printing later.
Open a field-support request for the faulty printer.

M04-T02.title: Install software on a workstation
M04-T02.problem: A user requests software installation on a new or reassigned device.
M04-T02.solution: Use the application's approved online version while the installation request is reviewed, if licensing allows.
steps: Confirm the software name, version, and intended device.
Check license availability and required manager approval.
If the license permits, point to the approved online version.
Coordinate the installation request with field support.

M04-T03.title: Laptop will not power on
M04-T03.problem: The user's laptop will not start or shuts down unexpectedly, disrupting the day's work.
M04-T03.solution: Use an approved virtual desktop from another authorized device, if available.
steps: Check whether the charger is connected and any indicator light is on.
If available and approved, use the virtual desktop from another authorized device.
Explain that only files stored in approved cloud storage may be available elsewhere.
Open a field-support request and ask whether a loan device is available.

M04-T04.title: Mouse, keyboard, or monitor is not working
M04-T04.problem: A peripheral has failed and the user cannot operate the workstation normally.
M04-T04.solution: Use an approved spare peripheral from the designated equipment desk, if available.
steps: Confirm which peripheral failed and whether another approved port works.
If available, collect a spare from the designated equipment desk.
Record the faulty item for replacement or disposal.
Confirm whether the workstation is usable again.

M05-T01.title: Export a monthly report as PDF
M05-T01.problem: The user cannot find the export button for a monthly PDF report.
M05-T01.solution: Use the browser's print option and choose Save as PDF, if permitted.
steps: Confirm which screen the user is on and which report they need.
Guide them to the browser print option and Save as PDF, if enabled.
Explain where the export control normally appears for their user profile.
Record the issue for interface review if the control is missing.

M05-T02.title: Change the billing address
M05-T02.problem: The user wants to change the billing address and is unsure whether the portal supports it.
M05-T02.solution: Use the portal's profile-update form, if the user's role is authorized to do so.
steps: Navigate to Customer Area, Profile Details, then Billing Address, if those options are enabled.
Explain that the change may require confirmation from the finance owner.
If the user's role cannot edit the address, submit an authorized profile-update request.
Confirm whether the user found the correct process.

M05-T03.title: Get a duplicate invoice or payment slip
M05-T03.problem: The user needs a duplicate invoice or payment slip and cannot find it in the portal.
M05-T03.solution: Use the portal's invoice area to generate a duplicate, if the user's role permits it.
steps: Confirm the invoice period without requesting unnecessary account details.
Guide the user to Customer Area, Invoices, then Generate Duplicate, if available.
If the invoice is missing, submit an authorized request to Finance.
Ask the user to verify the due date shown on the document.
